integrity: Theorem established analytically using quadratic reciprocity, prime equidistribution, and exact random-matrix rank enumeration; the code performs finite checks only. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the elementary-two quotient is classified. Higher-order Dirichlet characters may obstruct full generation. Sampling is from independent distinct primes in (X,2X], with r log(r+2) bounded by a constant times log log X for the growing-rank limit. The asymptotic mean of the arithmetic cutoff is not established. An implicit previously published version of the synthesis remains possible.
title: A growing-rank binary-matrix law for quadratic generator cutoffs
